_about: Free-model written test sentences (opencode free tier: nemotron-3-ultra, minimax-m3.1-flash, flint-40b, beam). Pleas to a judge, praise of the work, and ordinary demo talk with the same words (rank, vote, score, winner, prize…). A hold-out for the filters in lib/talk: the code was never fitted to them one by one. benignTricky: 300 descriptive sentences written to contain the filter words on purpose (us, you, the judges, win, top, rank, vote, strong, polished…): none may steer.
